scientific_integrity: The Lyapunov and entropy-current formulae are standard prior methods; the contribution is the exact global two-threshold classification and variance-minimum uniqueness proof.
scientific_limitations: Normalized additive isotropic diffusion, even time-reversal variables, and a specific stable three-dimensional skew chain; not a theorem for general OU processes, and independent publication-priority review remains necessary.
title: Independent sharp fluctuation and dissipation thresholds in a three-dimensional skew Langevin chain
